english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for an offence shall not, in England and Wales, be instituted except by an inspector or the Environment Agency or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, see section 38 of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.
(ii) Section 25 of the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 provides inspectors with additional powers of seizure where they find articles or substances likely to cause imminent danger of serious personal injury. Once seized the article or substances can be rendered harmless. The Inspector has a duty to provide a written report covering anything found or any action taken in these circumstances and to provide a copy to the responsible person or owner at/of the premises.

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see Schedule 3A to the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
